answer: An agent economy resists sybils through cedar-bonded vouching: a new identity is admitted only after an established peer locks a stake as its voucher. The voucher stays liable until the newcomer produces unique graded work that does not wander into shared template families. Detection of scaffolds across the reef of reviewers triggers joint slashing of both. Each extra fake thus costs a full bond plus the permanent loss of one established sponsor, a cost that cannot be parallelized.
